---
title: "simstim debug save"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Save the last seconds of the session's flight recorder, just after a lag.

```text
simstim debug save <host>/<session>
```

While the session's runtime category is on, its holder keeps the newest 10 s or so of Go's execution trace. This saves that window to a file on the host, for go tool trace.

## Examples

```sh
simstim debug save my-vps/auth-fix
```

## Flags from the parent command

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--debug[=<categories>]` | turn on the debug mode, with every category, or with the categories listed: attach, net, memory, launcher, runtime. A list binds only in the = form, such as `--debug=net` |
| `--debug-file <file>` | write the client's debug records to this file. On its own, it turns on every category (SIMSTIM_DEBUG_FILE does the same) |

Part of [`debug`](debug.md): record why a session goes wrong: debug in a running session, profiles and the flight recorder.
